description: Issue #839: a duplicate spanning two nesting depths. `dup` is declared at the top level on line 1 and again inside `define outer` on line 5, and `params.original_span` points at the top-level one — so the first-declaration map is shared across depths, not per-scope. That is the correct reading of phase-1 registration: `spec/execution-model.md:82-89` registers every `define`/`to` procedure into one callable table, and a nested `define` is registered and callable from anywhere (`define outer` / `define helper` / `helper` runs), so a second declaration of the same name genuinely collides no matter which body it sits in. The two bodies print different values, so a last-wins override would print `2` here. Companion to `nested-declaration-of-a-built-in-name`, which covers the `ol-reserved-word` half of the same depth axis.
